story.title: Importance Of Name
paragraphs_en: Story- Kalibai Gorilal Omprakash Kshatriya Prakash Gorilal lived in a village. He was absolutely black. That's why women used to make fun of him.

Once upon a time. Gorilal's wife- Kalibai, was going to bring water from the well. Many women were filling water there. One of those women made fun of her and said, "Look! Gorilal's wife Kalibai is coming. "
Kalibai understood the reason for their laugh. She was white. Her husband was completely black. While their names were completely opposite of their skin's color
﻿ So she came back home without filling water.
Then she said to her husband, "We should change our names."
" No !" Kalibai's husband explained to her, "Our names are as good as they are." Secondly, what is named in it? The person is identified by his work. "

But Kalibai did not listen. She wanted both of them to change their names. So that no one makes fun of them. After all, the husband had to give up in front of his wife's stubbornness. Then both decided to change their name.
Then both the husband and wife went in search of a good name. So that a good name can be found and kept.

They were going in the jugaad. When, On the way, they saw a husband fighting with a wife . The wife was screaming loudly. The poor husband was listening quietly. Both of them asked the reason for the fight and they tried to calm them down.
Then they asked their name, "What is your name?" The man replied, "My name is Krur Singh, And this is my wife Shantibai"
Kalibai was surprised to hear this. Shantibai was screaming and Krur Singh was sitting silent. Their name had nothing to do with their work. So they both moved forward.
On their way, they found two people on their way. The wife was holding her husband's hand. The husband was quietly following the wife.
On passing by, they found that the husband was visually disabled. Gorilal asked the blind man, "What is your name?"
To this the blind person replied, "My name is Nayansukh and this is my wife Ranibai." Both were begging for food and money.

On hearing this answer, Kalibai and Gorilal got into thinking. Here no name has any synergy with anyone's work. Because of this, they started discussing among themselves. In the end they came to the conclusion that
Shanti ko chillate dekha , Krursingh khada tha chup chap , Nayansukh ke nen nahi , Kali nam rakhe hai aap , Rani mang rahi hai bhikh , Namo ki hai kaisi seekh ,

After telling this, Kalibai said, "Swami! Whatever our name is , is good. " On hearing this, Gorilal also laughed, "Yes, what is there in our name ! The real thing is of work, ” And the two happily returned to their homes.
